title: Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department
heading: Why this record exists

lead: Record made so the war memorial and fallen-officer records can name the department each deputy served in. Not a lead; an account of why the record was created.

title: Sharlene Rose Duzick: Saugus Union School District board election, Trustee Area 5, November 8, 2022
heading: Probably Sharlene Rose Johnson
move: This candidate is probably Sharlene Rose Johnson, a trustee of the Santa Clarita Community College District from 2022 (person record #30263). Her district biography and SCVNews reports about Sharlene Duzick give the same presidency of JCI Santa Clarita Valley, the same seat on the College of the Canyons Foundation board (from July 2019) and the same work in real estate. No source names both, so the identification is probable, not established, and this candidacy is not linked to her record.
lead: Sharlene Rose Duzick (this candidacy) identified with Sharlene Rose Johnson, college trustee, person #30263: same JCI Santa Clarita Valley presidency, same College of the Canyons Foundation seat from July 2019, same real estate work. Now settled by the license record and The Signal (commit aff68f5); once the drafted links are applied, link this candidacy to #30263 and replace this note.
why: A suspected identity held back from linking, which is internal state; it is also superseded by the settled identification.

title: Maria Gutzeit
heading: Held for the elections work

lead: Single-source facts held back for Maria Gutzeit: final president of the Newhall County Water District and SCV Water vice president from January 2018 (SCV Water press release, 17 January 2018); lost the Division 3 seat in 2020 (preliminary news figures only). Settled by a second source for the presidency and the certified 2020 canvass for Division 3, entered with the officeHolding records. No year of birth in any official source.
why: The heading and text are a holding queue for the elections work; nothing in it is given to the reader as a fact on the page.

title: Charles Alexander Mentry
heading: Source fault: the birth year
move: Held as 1847?-03-27, uncertain in the year alone, until the sourceFault type exists to carry it.
becomes: The death certificate states the birth date as 27 March 1847 and the age at death, 4 October 1900, as 52 years, 6 months and 8 days, which counts back to 27 March 1848. The month and day agree; the year does not.
lead: Mentry's birth is held as 1847?-03-27, uncertain in the year alone, pending a sourceFault type to carry a disagreement inside one source. Settled when that type exists and the date is moved onto it.
why: Names a planned piece of the archive's software (the sourceFault type); the conflict inside the certificate stays for the reader.

title: California Battalion

move: This record was briefly merged into John C. Frémont's on 3 October 2026, on the mistaken view that no source names a California Battalion. Three sources in the archive name it, and two place it in this valley, so it has its own record again.
lead: California Battalion was merged into John C. Fremont's record on 3 October 2026 in error and restored: three sources in the archive name the battalion and two place it in this valley. Not a lead; edit history.
why: Internal edit history (a merge and its reversal); the heading 'Restored, 3 October 2026' should go with it.
